title: בְּ
content: בְּ prep. in, with, through, etc. (BH בְּ);—sf. ´בִּ:, בָּךְ Dn 4:6 + , 3 ms. בֵּהּ 3:7 +, f. בַּהּ 2:4, 3:16 +, 3 pl. בְּהוֺן 3:25 +;—1. in, of place, 2:38, 3:1, 4:12 בֶּאֱסוּר +; at Ezr 5:10, of time Dn 2:28, 3:5 (at), 5:2 +; 4:12, Ezr 4:16 ´חֲלָק בְּ: a share in (BH 1. 2). 2. into, Dn 2:38 יְהַב בִּידָךְ, Ezr 5:12; ´עֲדָה ב: pass over or upon Dn 3:27. 3. of the instrument, by, with Dn 2:30, 2:34, 3:4, 4:12 b, 4:24, 4:27 +; 5:2, 5:3 (Am 6:6: BH III. 2). 4. of the price (ib. III. 3), with, Ezr 7:17, 7:18 5. יוֺם בְּיוֺם Ezr 6:9 = day by day (ib. III. 3), end; so Syr. PS1577; cf. ירח בירח S-CL5, ܫܢܐ ܒܬܪܐ PS4240). 6. through, on account of, (ib. III.), Ezr 6:14. 7. in the matter of, Dn 6:6, 6:18, 8. after vbs. of ruling, Dn 2:38 +, trusting 6:24, looking at 7:8; עֲכַד בְּ to do with 4:32, Ezr 7:18, Cf. Lzb232 K§ 68.

title: בְּאֵשׁ
content:
[Str888,887,7489] † בְּאֵשׁ vb. be evil, bad (so Targum; Syr. ܒܐܫ; OAram. באש Lzb238 SAC27 Cooke191; cf. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. impers. עֲלוֺהִי ´ב: Dn 6:15 i.e. it was evil (displeasing) to him (cf. BH [רעע] 1).

[Str873] † [בִּאישׁ K§ 11:8b)] adj. bad (so Eg. Aram. Cooke75. 2; Targum בִּישׁ, Syr. ܒܐܫ);—fs.emph. וּבִאישְׁתָּא Ezr 4:12 rebellious and bad city (not בִּאוּשְׁתַָּא, v. Baern.).

[Str870] בָּאתַר, בָּתַר v. אֲתַר

[Str894–95] בָּבֶל n.pr.loc. Babylon (BH id.);—Dn 2:12 + 15 t. Dn, 9 t. Ezr.

[Str896] † [בָּֽבְלַי] adj. gent. pl. emph. as subst. בָּֽבְלָיֵא Ezr 4:9 the Babylonians.

title: בְּדַר
content: [Str921,967] † [בְּדַר] vb. Pa. scatter (so Targum Syr.; BH [בָּוַר]);—Imv. mpl. וּבַדַּ֫רוּ Dn 4:11 (acc. rei).

title: בְּהַל
content:
[Str927,926] † [בְּהַל] vb. Pa. alarm. dismay (so usu. Targum (not Syr.); BH [בָּהַל]);—Impf. . 3 ms. sf. יְבַהֲלָךְ Dn 4:16 and 3 mpl. sf. לֻגַּנִי- 4:2, 7:15, 7:28 (both juss. Str:§ 18 c M§ 52 a); לוּח- 5:10, לֵֻ+נּךְ- 4:16, לוּנֵהּ- 5:6. Hithpe. hasten (so Pi. in late BH; Targum Ithpe. (rare)); Inf. בְּהִתְבְּהָלָה = in haste (orig. ‘in alarm’) Dn 2:25, 3:24, 6:20. Hithpa. Pt. pass. מִתְבָּהַל Dn 5:9 was greatly alarmed.

[Str924] † בְּהִילוּ n.f. haste (Targum);—´בְּכ: Ezr 4:23 (K§ 61, 4).

title: בול
content: בול (assumed as prob. √ of foll. Brock Schulth; Lane277).

title: בָּל
content: [Str1079] † בָּל n.[m.] mind (Syr. ܒܠܐ id. PS529; Ar. بَالٌ heart);—abs. ´שָם ב: Dn 6:15 (sq. Inf.; cf. Syr. ܝܗܒ ܒܠܐ PSl.c. SchulthLex. 80).

title: בְּטֵל
content:
[Str988–89] † [בְּטֵל] vb. cease (late BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 fs. בְּטִלַת Ezr 4:24, Pt. fs. בָּֽטְלָא v:24 (both of work). Pa. make to cease, acc. Pers.: Pf. 3 mpl. בַּטִּ֫לוּ 4:23, 5:5; Inf. לְבַטָּלָא 4:21, acc. Pers. om. 6:3.

[Str996–97] † בֵּין prep. between (BH [בַּ֫יִן,] בֵּין; Targum, בֵּין, בֵּינֵי Syr. ܒܝܢܝ, ܒܝܢܬ), Dn 7:5; c. sf. 3 pl. m. בֵּינֵיהוֺן v:7 Kt (Qr 3 pl. f. בֵּינֵיהֵן).

[Str998–99] ‡ † בִּינָה n.f. understanding (BH; √; Targum בִּיוּנָא, Syr. ܒܘܝܢܐ);—abs. ´ב: Dn 2:21.

[Str1001,1002] † בִּירְתָא (Baer תָּא -) n.f. emph. castle (so Egypt. Aram. REvS361. A 5; B 1, 2 S-CPap. B 3, C 16 +; Nab. = temple CISii. 164. 3; BH בִּירָה);—Ezr 6:2.

title: בַּ֫יִת
content:
[Str1004–05] [בַּ֫יִת]:44 n.m.:Ezr 6:7 house (BH כַּ֫יִת);—emph. בַּיְתָ֫א Ezr 5:3 +, תָ֫ה - 5:12, 6:15; cstr. (־)בֵּית 4:24, 5:2 +; sf. בַּיְתִי Dn 4:1 (Baern., cf. M§ 76 c; van d. H. Gi בֵּיתִי), בַּיְהֵתּ 2:17 +; pl. sf. בָּֽתֵּיכוֺן Dn 2:5;—† 1. house, of men : Ezr 6:11, 6:11, Dn 2:5, 2:17, 3:29, 6:11; of king Ezr 6:4, Dn 4:4, מִשְׁתְּיָא ´ב: 5:10, גִּנְוַיָא דִּי מִלְכָּא ´ב: Ezr 5:17, cf. 7:20 = ´סִפְרַיָא וגו :´ב: 6:1; מִלְכוּ ´ב: 4:30 royal residence (of Bab.). 2. house of God, temple at Jerusalem Dn 5:3, 5:23, Ezr 4:24 + 28 t. Ezr.

[Str956] † [בִּית DWB 52] vb. denom. (lodge,) pass the night (Targum id.);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. בָּת Dn 6:19.

[Str1079] בָּל v. בול

title: בְּלַא
content:
[Str1080] † [בְּלַא] vb. Pa. wear away, out (BH בלה);—Impf. 3 ms. יְבַּלֵּא Dn 7:25, fig. for harass continually (acc. Pers.).

[Str1093] † בְּלוֺ n.[m.] tribute (loan-word from As. biltu, √ ובל, acc. to most mod.; but Scheft80 cp. OIran. bali, tribute, OPers. *bari, payment in kind, so (in Bab. bara) MeyG.d.Altert.iii.88 ScheftMGWJ 47 (1903), 316 Buhl14 ‘vielleicht’);—abs. מִנְדְּה וַהֲלָח ´ב: Ezr 4:13, 4:20, 7:24.

[Str1096,1095] בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר:8 n.pr.m. Bab. name of Daniel (BH id., p. 117);—Dn 2:26, 4:5 + 6 t. Dn; Βαλτασαρ.

[Str1113,1112] † בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר n.pr.m. king of Bab., acc. to Dn 5:1, 5:2, 5:9, 5:22, 5:29 (BH id., p. 128) = בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר v:30, 7:1; Βαλτασαρ; vid. BevEncy. Bib. BELSHAZZAR DrDu xxviii f..

title: בְּבָה
content: [Str1124,1129] † [בְּבָה בְּנָא] vb. build (BH בָּנָךְ);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. sf. 3 ms. בְּנָ֫הִי Ezr 5:11; 1 S. sf. בֶּנַיְתַהּ Dn 4:27; Impf. 3 mpl. יִבְנוֺן Ezr 6:7; Inf. לְמִבְנֵא 5:2 +, לְמִבְבְיָה v:9 (rd. לְמִבְנֵא M§ 64 u or < לְמִבְנֵה, so S-CA 8. 64), לִבְּנֵא (rd. לְמִבְנֵא Str:§ 231 M1. c.) v:3, v:13; Pt. act. pl. בָּנַ֫יִן 4:12 +; pass. בְּנֵה 5:11 (v. on forms K§ 47, Belsp. pass.);—build: c. acc. of temple Ezr 5:2, 5:3, 5:9, 5:11, 5:13, 5:17, 6:7, 6:8, so 5:4 (acc. cogn.); pass. of temple v:11; c. acc. of city 4:12, Dn 4:27; abs. Ezr 6:14, 6:14. Hithpe. be built: Impf. 3 ms. יִתְבְּנֵא of temple Ezr 5:15, 6:3; 3 fs. תִּתְבְּנֵא of city v:13, v:16, v:21; Pt. מִתְבְּנֵא of temple 5:8 (c. acc. mater.), v:16.

title: בִּנְיָן
content: [Str1147] † [בִּנְיָן] n.[m.] a building (so Targum Syr.);—emph. בִּנְיָנָא Ezr 5:4.

title: בְּנַס
content: [Str1149] † בְּנַס vb. be angry (TargumJ id.; Sam. ࠁࠍࠎ);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. וּקֽצַך שַגִּיא ´ב: Dn 2:12.

title: בְּעָא
content:
[Str1156,1158] † בְּעָא vb. ask, seek, only Dn (BH בעה (rare));—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´ב: 2:16, 2:49; 3 mpl. בְּעוֺ v:13; 1 pl. בְּעֵ֫ינָא v:23; Impf. 3 ms. יִבְעֵא 6:8, 6:13; 1 S. אֶבְעֵ־א 7:16; Inf. לְמִבְעֵא 2:18; Pt. בָּעֵא 6:12, 6:14, pl. בָּעַ֫יִן v:5;—1. ask, request, c. מִן Pers. 2:16 (obj. cl. c. דִּי), v:49, 7:16 (+ acc. rei); ask of God 2:23 (+ id.), of God or man 6:8 (+ acc. cogn.), v:13; c. מִן־קֳדָם of God 2:18 (acc. rei); = pray, ´וּמִתְחַנֵּקֳדָם א :´ב: 6:12, ´ב: v:14. 2. seek, acc. Pers. 2:13, acc. rei 6:5. Pa. Impf. 3 mpl. יְבַעוֺן (K§ 47:3); Mad loc. conj. יִבְעוֺן) 4:33 resort (for favours) to, ל Pers.

[Str1159, 1156] † בָּעוּ (K§ 61:4) n. f. petition (Targum Syr.);—abs. ´ב: Dn 6:8; sf. בָּעוּתֵהּ v:14 (both acc. cogn. c. בְּעָא).

title: בְּעֵל
content:
[Str1169,1167] † בְּעֵל (K§ 54:3 γ) n. m. owner, lord (Syr. ܒܥܠ, used similarly; cf. BH בַּ֫עַל, √ בָּעַל; also Targum בְּעֵיל);—cstr. ־מְעֵם´בּ: Ezr 4:8, 4:9, 4:17 i.e. commander (AndrM 56* as translation of Persian framātār, commander).

[Str1236–37] † [בְּקְעָא] n. f. plain (Targum; BH בְּקְעָה, √ בקע; cf. Syr. ܦܩܥܬܐ, √ ܦܩܥܥ);—cstr. בְבִקְעַת דּוּרָא Dn 3:1.

title: בְּקַר
content:
[Str1240,1239] † [בְּקַר] vb. Pa. inquire, seek (only Ezr) (Targum Syr.; v. BH);—Pf. 3 mpl. בַּקַּ֫רוּ 4:19, 6:1; Impf. 3 ms. יְבַקַּר 4:15; Inf. לְבַקָּרָה 7:14;—1. inquire, c. עַל (rei) concerning 7:14; c. subj. indef., = pass., 4:19 search was made, so 6:1, 4:15. Hithpa. Impf. 3 ms. יִתְבַּקַּר 5:17, impers., let search be made.

[Str1247,1121,1248,1123,1121] †I. בַּר n.m. son (Targum id.; Syr. ܒܪ, Mand. ברא NöM § 148, OAram. Nab. Palm. בר (and בן) Lzb242 f.; Sab. בר acc. to MordtmVOJ x. 154 f.; = בֵּן, ן becoming ר, PhilippiZMG xxxii (1878), 36 ff. BrockSyr. Gr. § 76 al.; √ diff. fr. בן acc. to JHMich Thes K§ 63 al.; BH בַּר Aramaism for בֵּן);—cstr. ´ב: Dn 3:25 +; sf. בְּרֵהּ 5:22; pl. cstr. בְּנֵי Ezr 6:9 +; sf. בְּנ֫וֺהִי 6:10, 7:23, בְּנֵיהוֺן Dn 6:25;—1. son(s) Ezr 5:1, 5:2, 5:2, 6:14, Dn 5:22, 6:25, Ezr 6:10, 7:23; בְּנֵי יִשְרָאֵל 6:16 = Israelites, בְּנֵי גָלוּתָא = captives v:16, Dn 2:25, 5:13, 6:14; בַּר־אֱנָשׁ 7:13 i.e. one of human kind, בְּנֵי אֲנָשָׁא men 2:38, 5:21; בַּר־אֱלָהִין 3:25 a divine (or angelic) being (v. Dr, and cf. BH Gn 6:2, Jb 1:6); ´בַּר שְׁנִין וגו: 6:1 a son of 62 years = 62 years old (BH בֵּן 9). 2. of bullocks, בְּנֵי תוֺרִין Ezr 6:9.

title: II בַּר
content: [Str1251] II. בַּר v. ברר

title: בְּרַךְ
content:
[Str1288,1289] † [בְּרַךְ] vb. kneel, bless (so BH);—Pe Pt. 1. act. בָּרֵךְ עַל־בִּרְכוֺ֫הִי Dn 6:11 kneeling on his knees (in prayer). 2. pass. בְּרִיךְ Dn 3:28 blessed (be) the God, etc. Pa. bless, praise: Pf. 3 ms. בָּרִךְ 2:19, 1 S. בָּֽתְכֵת (K§ 39:3) 4:31, both c. ל of God; Pt. pass. מְבָרַךְ 2:20 the name of God (be) blessed.

[Str1291] † [בְּרַךְ] n. [f.] knee;—pl. sf. בִּרְכ֫וֺהִי Dn 6:11.

[Str755] † [אַרְכֻבָּה] n. f. id. (by transp.; cf. Targum רְכוּבָא, TargumJ אַרְכּוּבְתָּא; Chr-Pal. ܐܪܟܘܒܬܐ SchwallyIdiot. 89 (who > expl. from √ רכב, cf. SchulthLex. 194); Ar. رُكْبَةٌ id.);—pl. sf. אַרְכֻבָּתֵהּ Dn 5:6 his knees.

title: בְּרַם
content: [Str1297] † בְּרַם adv. with advers. force, only, nevertheless (der. uncertain: NöM 202 = מָא + בָּר, lit. except what: Targum בְּרַם oft. for אַח, אוּלָם; Syr. ܒܪܡ Ex 9:16, 21:21, and in NT for πλήν; Chr-Pal. ܒܪܢ, ܒܪܝܢ);—Dn 2:28, 4:12 hew down the tree etc., שְׁבֻקוּ…בְּרַם: only leave the stump, etc., v:20, 5:17, Ezr 5:13.

title: ברר
content: [Str1250,1305] ברר (√ of foll.; BH ברר, בָּר † Jb 39:4).

title: בַּר
content:
[Str1251] † בַּר n.[m.] open field;—emph. בָּרָא, in ´חֵיוַת ב: (= BH חַיִּת הַשָּדֶה), Dn 2:38, 4:9, 4:18, 4:20, 4:22, 4:29; ´דִּתְאָא דִּי ב: v:12, v:20.

[Str1321] † בְּשַר n.m. flesh (Targum בְּסַר, Syr. ܒܣܪ; BH בָּשָר, √ בשר);—abs. ´ב: Dn 7:5 flesh (as devoured by beast); emph. בְּשְרָא 2:11 flesh = mankind, ´כָּל־ב: 4:9 = all creatures.

[Str1325,1324] † [בַּת] n.[m.] bath, liquid measure (Targum; perh. loan-word from BH II. בַּת, √ בתת);—pl. abs. בַּתִּין Ezr 7:22, 7:22.

[Str870] בָּתַר v. sub אֲתַר. p. 1083
